input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When describing the harmful plants, add a physical reaction to show the danger: “他吃了以后，肚子疼了起来。”
2. At the point where he records his discoveries, add one concrete detail about what he writes: “他记下了植物的颜色、味道和用处。”
3. When he talks with his friends, add a short line of speech: “这种植物对身体有好处，可以做药。”

ideas.reason: This gives a concrete physical reaction that clearly shows a plant is dangerous.
This adds specific details to what Shennong records without changing the story.
This is a simple, fitting line of speech for when he shares his discoveries with friends.
